lines.speaker: Tien
lines.text: Y'know, you keep reacting, trying to prompt us to ask what's going on.

lines.speaker: Tien
lines.text: Wow - I didn't think Goku had it in him (!)

lines.speaker: King Kai
lines.text: He doesn't. Freeza did it to himself...

lines.speaker: Freeza
lines.text: HAAAAH! MY ORGANS! Stay in there! Stay in your home! Daddy needs you!

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Wow, Freezer. You really were a *cut* above the rest!

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: But too bad you didn't make the *cut*!

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Guess you could call this a slice of life.

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Alright then, I'll cut you a break. I'm gonna split.

lines.speaker: Freeza
lines.text: I, I know I've a lot of terrible things... killed quite a number of people, some of which you liked... uh, but may I ask you... as one neighbor to another... can you spare a cup of energy?

lines.speaker: King Kai
lines.text: NO! NO! NO! NO! NO! NO! NO! NO!

lines.speaker: Tien
lines.text: I'm not even asking any more...

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Now, be responsible with this energy! Don't use it to hurt any more people! Or on the drugs.

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: I'm gonna go now. Got a long trip home.

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: I'd ask if I could take one of your legs with me, but you're probably hungry too. Bye!

lines.speaker: Freeza
lines.text: 'He gave me his energy and... left me...'

lines.speaker: Freeza
lines.text: 'Maybe this is, my second... and last... chance...'

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: God dang it Freezer, now I have to give you more!

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: 'Huh... don't see him anymore. Guess he took the energy and left.'

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: 'Speaking of which, where am I going?'

lines.speaker: King Kai
lines.text: OK, you win! Goku blew Freeza up!

lines.speaker: King Kai
lines.text: Well, not as hard as it's gonna be to get off Namek.

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: 'Where am I? Where's my ship?! Everything looked the same before, now looks all the same but on *fire*!'

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: The controls! Where is it? Where is it?!

lines.speaker: King Kai
lines.text: Goku could not escape the explosion. Namek is gone... and so is he.

lines.speaker: Tien
lines.text: Why do any of you care? Are you forgetting the whole reason that they went to Namek in the first place?

lines.speaker: Tien
lines.text: Now we have *two* sets of Dragon Balls!

lines.speaker: Yamcha
lines.text: Well, yeah, but you make it sound like death has no consequence!

lines.speaker: Tien
lines.text: It really *doesn't* - we're literally waiting to go back. Hell, this is Chiaotzu's second time!

lines.speaker: Chiaotzu
lines.text: Next time I get a free sundae!

lines.speaker: King Kai
lines.text: So, who wants to tell Bulma?

lines.speaker: Yamcha
lines.text: Let me do it. Bulma's my girl.

lines.speaker: King Kai
lines.text: PFEH! Yeah, OK. Go ahead, stud.

lines.speaker: Mouri
lines.text: And now that I have devoured Guru, I have become the new Grand Elder!

lines.speaker: Bulma
lines.text: Oh, hey, hold on a moment, my ex is calling me.

lines.speaker: Yamcha
lines.text: Hey girl, let's get t--... wait, "ex"? What's that about?

lines.speaker: Bulma
lines.text: Yeah, I'm breaking up with you.

lines.speaker: Bulma
lines.text: Oh, well, that's not stopping you NOW, is it?

lines.speaker: Yamcha
lines.text: Do not do this right now!

lines.speaker: Bulma
lines.text: Hey, you wanna know how this is ending? Hey Vegeta, wanna come live with me?

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: Only if its got a pool.

lines.speaker: Bulma
lines.text: Well then, I guess he's just more of a man than you, isn't he?

lines.speaker: King Kai
lines.text: Yeah, OK, I'm gonna take over, this isn't going anywhere.

lines.speaker: King Kai
lines.text: Gohan's fatherless and the Namekians are homeless. So... that's a thing.

lines.speaker: King Kai
lines.text: Now have fun delivering the message, I've gotta go cast up Yamcha's leg.

lines.speaker: Bulma
lines.text: Huh... well, uh... Gohan, Goku's dead.

lines.speaker: Bulma
lines.text: Ssso, until we can use the Dragon Balls... who wants a big old sleepover?

lines.speaker: Mouri
lines.text: You think you can accommodate the entirety of my people?

lines.speaker: Bulma
lines.text: My Dad's a billionaire genius playboy philanthropist.

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: Wait... I feel a dark presence on that ship...

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: And so, the Namekians were relocated to the Briefs' compound.

lines.speaker: Dr. Briefs
lines.text: So honey, you say all of these are your friends from high school?

lines.speaker: Dr. Briefs
lines.text: Tell them to keep out of my Scotch!

lines.speaker: Golf Commentator
lines.text: Tricky bit of putting here; very difficult to read from this angle and the green's up and running rather fast today.

lines.speaker: Golf Commentator
lines.text: Mouri looks like he's aiming slightly to the right of the hole, and... good for par.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The Namekian children learned strip poker.

lines.speaker: Dende
lines.text: Alright, sprouts... lay 'em on the table.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Gohan caught up on his studies...

lines.speaker: Chi-Chi
lines.text: You read it! You learn it! You love it!

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: But Mom, I've already read Huck Finn.

lines.speaker: Chi-Chi
lines.text: Yes, but this one has the N-word taken out!

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Piccolo... did his usual thing; only with company.

lines.speaker: Nail
lines.text: 'So, uh, you wanna go hang out with our race?'

lines.speaker: Nail
lines.text: ''Cause, you know, this may be the last chance we'll ever get.'

lines.speaker: Nail
lines.text: 'You're not meditating, you're *napping*! I know the difference.'

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Vegeta did what he does best...

lines.speaker: Dr. Briefs
lines.text: Son of a bitch took ma Scotch!

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: And soon four months (or one Namekian year) passed, and the Namekian Dragon Balls became ready for use.

lines.speaker: Dende
lines.text: During our time squatting here on Earth, we taught the Dragon how to speak English!

lines.speaker: Bulma
lines.text: Wait a second, I just thought of something. Maybe we shouldn't do this out in the middle of the--

lines.speaker: Police Officer
lines.text: Godzirra, Godzirra. Godzirra, Godzirra, Godzirra. Godzirra, Godzirra.

lines.speaker: Porunga
lines.text: You have summoned the great Porunga! Make your wish, and I--

lines.speaker: Dende
lines.text: OK, listen, I'm sure you get this a lot, but can we just get, like, six wishes?

lines.speaker: Dende
lines.text: 'Cus we're just gonna bring you back in four months and do this crap again.

lines.speaker: Dende
lines.text: Plus, we're just bringing some schmucks back to life.

lines.speaker: Porunga
lines.text: Well, that is unconventional. But considering the ease of these wishes, I will accommodate--

lines.speaker: Porunga
lines.text: Oh, that's just a dick move!

lines.speaker: Dende
lines.text: Alright, let's get the hard one out of the way.

lines.speaker: Dende
lines.text: Dragon! Build the Namekians a new Namek!

lines.speaker: Dende
lines.text: Sweet. Alright, you guys do whatever you want.

lines.speaker: Chiaotzu
lines.text: Oh hey, we're back! Kinda want that sundae though...

lines.speaker: Yamcha
lines.text: Wah! Water in my cast! I'm gonna get gangrene! Aaah!

lines.speaker: Dende
lines.text: And I guess you wanna wish back your dad now, huh?

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: Actually, we wanna save him for last.

lines.speaker: Dende
lines.text: ...Yeah. Like I said, you wanna wish your dad back, right?

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: Dende, we have to wish Krillin back.

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: Eh, just give him a minute.

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: And now, last but not least: Bring back my *Dad*!

lines.speaker: Porunga
lines.text: The one called Goku is still alive!

lines.speaker: Bulma
lines.text: That's great! Then just wish him here.

lines.speaker: Porunga
lines.text: Uhh, sorry. Can't do that either.

lines.speaker: Porunga
lines.text: The one called Goku wishes not to return!

lines.speaker: Dende
lines.text: He said your father wishes not to return--

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: I heard what he said! I want an explanation!

lines.speaker: Porunga
lines.text: Well, I'm sorry. Wishing all your other friends back to life and building a *planet* has left me a *little* worn out!

lines.speaker: Porunga
lines.text: He doesn't wanna come back. End of story. Now if you have another wish for me, I can try that.

lines.speaker: Dende
lines.text: Gohan, I... I know it must be hard... but maybe your dad is off somewhere else, doing something really important.

lines.speaker: Dende
lines.text: I just want you to know that... that I'm here for you and, and that... I... I love you.

lines.speaker: Dende
lines.text: Wha... what did I... d-did I say it too soon? Oh God, I said it too soon! Oh God, I f**ked it up!

lines.speaker: Dende
lines.text: DRAGON! Take everyone from Old Namek and put them on New Namek!

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: This ship will take me where I need to go. Now I can train, without *anyone* bothering me--

lines.speaker: Nappa
lines.text: Hey! It's me. Don't ask me how I got this number; I've got people.

lines.speaker: Nappa
lines.text: OK, listen. I figured out that they used the Dragon Balls to wish back *everyone* that was killed by Freeza's men. Technically, you worked for Freeza when you killed me, so BAM, Nappa's back baby! WOOHWOOH!

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: What about all the ones *you* killed?

lines.speaker: Nappa
lines.text: Well, technically I worked for you, but that has *changed*.

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: What, are they doing a live adaptation of "Mr. Clean"?

lines.speaker: Nappa
lines.text: Ha! That's hilarious! Find me the guy who writes your material and give me his number, because I'm a producer now!

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: Of course you are. What do you even *do*?

lines.speaker: Nappa
lines.text: Actually, I'm in charge of this new project; wrote it myself!

lines.speaker: Nappa
lines.text: It's about this one guy who's killed tragically by his best friend, but then comes back as a ghost and haunts him!

lines.speaker: Nappa
lines.text: Merchandising rights alone are gonna make a f**king mint! We just singed on this great new actor, too - name's Mark Satan.

lines.speaker: Nappa
lines.text: Need to work on the first name, thinking "Hercule". What d'ya think?

lines.speaker: Nappa
lines.text: What do I care, you're not on my Board!

lines.speaker: Nappa
lines.text: Listen - I'll see you around, and when you're back on Earth, give me a call.

♫ Karadajû ni hirogaru panorama ♫ (While a panorama spreads through my body)
♫ Kao o kerareta chikyû ga okotte (okotte) ♫ (Kicked in the face, the Earth gets angry (gets angry))
♫ Kazan o bakuhatsu saseru ♫ (And makes a volcano explode)
♫ Toketa kôri no naka ni ♫ (Within the melted polar ice)
♫ Kyôryû ga itara tamanori shikomitai ne ♫ (If there’s a dinosaur, I want to train it to balance on a ball)
♫ Mune ga pachi-pachi suru hodo ♫ (Just as loudly as my heart pounds)

segments.title: MY ORGANS!
segments.quote: HAAAAH! MY ORGANS! Stay in there! Stay in your home! Daddy needs you! / Guess you could call this a slice of life.

segments.title: A Cup of Energy
segments.quote: ...as one neighbor to another... can you spare a cup of energy? / NO! NO! NO! NO! / Now, be responsible with this energy! ... Or on the drugs.

segments.title: Maybe I Was Wrong... Naaah!
segments.quote: '*Maybe*... I was wrong.' / *Naaah*! / God dang it Freezer, now I have to give you more!

segments.title: And So Is He
segments.quote: *There*! / *YES*!! / YAAAAAAAAY--! / Goku could not escape the explosion. Namek is gone... and so is he.

segments.title: Death Has No Consequence
segments.quote: Hell, this is Chiaotzu's second time! / Next time I get a free sundae!

segments.title: My Good Leg
segments.quote: *I have been dead*! / Well then, I guess he's just more of a man than you, isn't he? / Tenshinhan. / DOOHH-HOOHH, MY GOOD LEG!!

segments.title: Gohan, Goku's Dead
segments.quote: Gohan, Goku's dead. / Dammit! / Namekians, your planet blew up. / DAMMIT! / My Dad's a billionaire genius playboy philanthropist.

segments.title: Namekian Sleepover Montage
segments.quote: Alright, sprouts... lay 'em on the table. / Yes, but this one has the N-word taken out! / 'You're not meditating, you're *napping*!'

segments.title: That's Just a Dick Move
segments.quote: ...can we just get, like, six wishes? / And a planet. / Oh, that's just a dick move! / Donezo.

segments.title: I Said It Too Soon
segments.quote: I just want you to know that... I... I love you. / Wh--... what? / Oh God, I said it too soon! Oh God, I f**ked it up!

segments.title: Nappa's Back, Baby
segments.quote: Technically, you worked for Freeza when you killed me, so BAM, Nappa's back baby! WOOHWOOH!

segments.title: Citizen Nappa
segments.quote: I call it, "Citizen Nappa"! / ...name's Mark Satan. Need to work on the first name, thinking "Hercule".
